root_cause_category: A. Model reasoning failure & F. Incorrect model/tool interaction
root_cause: The 3B parameter model (llama3.2:latest) attempted invalid tool call schemas (passing empty {} to execute_command) and encountered tool search miss. Upon receiving tool error/empty feedback, the model prematurely halted ReAct tool execution and outputted hypothetical Markdown prose rather than using file tools (read_file, write_file) to inspect and modify the codebase.
evidence: API Call #1: Model called execute_command({}) without required 'command' argument, returning TypeError.
API Call #1: Model called search_files with DaemonThreadPoolExecutor exception when compat was uninitialized.
API Call #2: Model received tool error feedback and halted ReAct loop with finish_reason='stop'.
Workspace Mutation: Model made 0 file edits to the workspace.
Acceptance Checker: Failed because required pagination endpoint logic was not created by the agent.

comparison_with_successful_benchmarks.difference: Model received specific role authorization requirements, executed read_file and edit_file tools cleanly.
Model ran tests, received explicit traceback feedback, and applied targeted code edit.
Model followed structured prompt instructions and invoked development file/testing tools sequentially.

possible_remediations.option: Tool Schema Parameter Sanitization & Default Argument Handling
possible_remediations.expected_benefit: Prevents TypeError when 3B model invokes execute_command with empty arguments.

possible_remediations.option: Product Layer System Prompt Error Recovery Guidance
possible_remediations.expected_benefit: Guides model to recover from tool errors by listing directory structure or reading files.

possible_remediations.option: Model Provider Scale Upgrade (e.g., Llama 3.3 70B or Qwen 2.5 14B/32B)
possible_remediations.expected_benefit: Provides superior schema adherence and multi-step ReAct resilience for open-ended exploration prompts.
